ranking.reason: Inner x loop makes complexity O(n*m^4) (~10^15 for n=m=1000); algorithm is logically right but this loop causes TLE on max tests.
Per-step cost p^3*m comes from iterating all states and all x separately; needs prefix-sum restructuring to fit limits.
Skipping x>c is correct logically, but the per-x branching here is what prevents collapsing states into a faster transition.
Final sum over strict triples is correct; included only because over/undercounting, if any, would surface here.
